request: In the watchlist, show movies I haven't watched yet before the ones I've watched.

requests.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when the checkbox is clicked
requests.reason: The assertion re-queried `items()[0]` after the click. With the required ordering, toggling Movie 1 makes it watched, so it is partitioned to the end of the rendered list and the first row becomes Movie 2, whose checkbox is unchecked. I captured the clicked checkbox element before the click and assert on that element; the test's intent (clicking the checkbox toggles watched for that movie) and all other assertions are unchanged. Without this edit the test cannot pass together with the new display order.

requests.title: Watchlist > toggles watched when blank space on the row is clicked
requests.reason: Same conflict: the final assertion re-queried `items()[0]`, which after the toggle is Movie 2 (now first because Movie 1 became watched and moved to the bottom). I capture the Movie 1 checkbox before the row click and assert on it; the interaction tested (clicking blank row space toggles watched) is unchanged.
